lines.text: You said the third level hums? Rock doesn't hum, Tycho. Instruments hum.
It's the crystal seams. The light in them moves, and the note sits under your feet.

Moving light, a held note, louder near the growths. Then the crystals aren't decoration, they're doing something. Instruments hum because something plays them. I want to know what's playing the third floor. Don't touch. Describe.
